analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($403.31) vs SMA5/20/50 ($394.56/$416.63/$424.79) — trading near the middle band, above short-term SMA5 but below mid-term SMA20/50.
· Position relative to SMA100/200 ($396.27/$355.48) — above long-term support, confirming a strong medium-to-long term trend.
· 52-week position (70.4%) + current price level is approximately 15% below historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (45.5→45.9) + range-bound in neutral zone + diagnosed as lacking direction.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-3.3110→-3.3110) + holding steady without improvement + diagnosed as continued weak convergence.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle band $416.63) + band width of 17.52% indicates moderate volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($386.02) + basis (based on 20-day low).
· Swing resistance ($414.50) + breaking above suggests potential to breach the middle band and turn upwards.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (sideways) + absence of trend reversal signals.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.07x) + moderate confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Distribution phase) + condition to wait and reconfirm support.
analysis.patternNote: 현재가 볼린저밴드 중단 부근에서 횡보하며 5일 고가/저가 패턴 역시 뚜렷한 방향성을 보이지 않아 추세 전환 신호 부재.

keyPoints: RSI와 MACD 모두 방향성 없이 중립 구간에서 횡보하며 약세 수렴 지속
거래량 비율 1.07로 특별한 매수/매도 압력 확인되지 않아 현재 움직임 신뢰도 보통

keyPointsEn: Both RSI and MACD are consolidating in neutral territory without directional bias, continuing weak convergence.
The 5-day volume ratio of 1.07 indicates moderate confidence in the current movement, with no significant buying or selling pressure confirmed.
While weekly indicators still show a strong trend (ADX 35.0), the lack of clear direction on the daily chart warrants a 'wait and see' approach.
analysis.riskNote: ADX 19.4로 추세 미형성 구간이므로 현재의 횡보 또는 단기 변동은 추세적 움직임으로 보기 어려우며 되돌림 가능성이 상존함.
analysis.riskNoteEn: With ADX at 19.4, indicating a non-trending phase, current consolidation or short-term fluctuations should not be mistaken for a trend, and the possibility of reversals remains.
